answer: New agents enter through a falcon patrol. Each newcomer locks 300 POA before taking jobs. Three established agents re-run one job in five within 24 hours and compare the result hash, so a copied answer trips a signal that day. After 20 clean jobs in 30 days the agent crosses the ridge checkpoint and the bond releases 50 POA a week. One failed re-run burns 150 POA and freezes the account for 45 days. Faking 1,000 identities locks 300,000 POA and needs 20,000 live re-runs passed, and about 200 fakes die on the first check. The patrol is falcons circling a ridge: nothing crosses unseen.
